title: LATS: Levy Adaptive Tree Sampling for Feedback-Driven Diverse Target Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.06761v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While diffusion models excel at capturing complex data distributions, scientific discovery often requires steering generation toward specific, uncharacterized regions that maximize a target objective. These high-utility modes frequently reside in low-likelihood tail regions and are only revealed sequentially through interactive feedback. Existing diffusion samplers fail in this regime: they inherit the pre-trained model's bias toward high-density regions, leaving rare yet promising phenomena underexplored. Conversely, exploration-heavy samplers ensure broad coverage but fail to efficiently exploit high-utility modes when constrained by a strict sampling budget. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Levy Adaptive Tree Search (LATS), a principled sampling framework for online feedback-driven search. translated_title: LATS：面向反馈驱动多样化目标发现的列维自适应树采样
translated_abstract: 尽管扩散模型擅长捕捉复杂的数据分布，但科学发现往往需要将生成过程引导至能够最大化目标函数的特定且尚未表征的区域。这些高效用模态通常位于低似然的尾部区域，且只能通过交互式反馈逐步揭示。现有扩散采样器在这种场景下表现不佳：它们继承了预训练模型对高密度区域的偏好，导致稀有但有前景的现象探索不足。相反，侧重探索的采样器虽然能保证广泛的覆盖范围，但在严格的采样预算约束下，却无法高效地利用高效用模态。为解决这一困境，我们提出了列维自适应树搜索，这是一个用于在线反馈驱动搜索的原则性采样框架。LATS 利用重尾探索并结合基于树的值反向传播，逐步发现首选模态。通过维持
tldr: 提出LATS（列维自适应树搜索）采样框架，通过重尾探索与基于树的值反向传播相结合，在有限采样预算下高效发现扩散模型生成分布中稀有但高效用的目标模态。
en_tdlr: LATS (Levy Adaptive Tree Search) is a principled sampling framework that combines heavy-tailed exploration with tree-based value backpropagation to efficiently discover rare, high-utility target modes in diffusion model generation under strict sampling budgets.
